reason: A visual layer plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web profile that adds mecha-themed artwork, a non-interactive HUD, background treatment, and responsive framing without changing agent, session, or tool behavior.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 配置提供机甲风格艺术资源、非交互式 HUD、背景效果和响应式视觉框架。
summaries.en: Adds mecha-themed artwork, a non-interactive HUD, background treatment, and responsive visual framing to a DeepSeek Harness Web profile.

capabilities: Adds a non-interactive HUD and background treatment
Provides responsive visual framing for the web shell
Activates Host and browser visual layers through a plugin bundle
